normalization.title: The Robot Is the Easy Part. The Boundaries Are the Engineering.
normalization.overview: A creator-integrated desktop robot reveals why account authority, privacy paths and physical feedback matter more than the spectacle.
normalization.whyItMatters: A multi-model demonstration does not establish one model's benchmark quality, enforced tool permissions or physical reliability.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Separate sensor observation, local routing, remote services and account action rights; test stop/recovery with synthetic data.

archiveCall.label: The boundaries make it a system
archiveCall.text: Test physical feedback, explicit permissions, data-flow custody and recovery before granting real-world authority.

normalization.falsification: Repeat representative voice/tool tasks with latency, false wakes, revoked send permission and noisy-motor recovery measured under defined conditions.
normalization.freshness: Vendor authentication rules, model versions and service terms can change; recheck before reuse.
